'''Bongiovi''' was a [[shudderup]] [[Quetarra|quetarrist]] and [[Musician/Legends|singer]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] who was active during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. During the war he worked with the [[Naboo Royal Advisory Council/Legends|royal]] [[Music Advisor/Legends|Music Advisor]] [[Hela Brandes/Legends|Hela Brandes]], the classical composer [[Tofli Argala]], the [[Gungan/Legends|gungan]] bandleader [[Augara Jowil/Legends|Augara Jowil]], to persuade the [[symponik]] master composer [[Beezar Pert/Legends|Beezar Pert]] to preform at a charity [[Theed Palace Plaza concert|concert]]. The concert was held in the [[Palace Plaza/Legends|Palace Plaza]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of Naboo, and sold out tickets, with all profits being used to help children orphaned during the Clone Wars on both sides of the conflict.<ref name="ST" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bongiovi was first mentioned in ''[[Slugthrowers: An Overview of Popular Music and Musicians in a Galaxy Far, Far Away]]'', an article published in [[2013]] on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|blog]] and written by [[Edward M. Erdelac]].
